# Synthetic cohort v1 oracle

All reference bases are A; this is synthetic, not a human reference or patient data.
Assembly enum GRCh38 is only an engine-test tag, not evidence of real provenance.
`001` and `Örnek-A` are cases; `ctrl-01` and `ctrl-02` controls. UTF-8 spelling and
leading zeros must survive. A missing VCF row means unobserved.

| POS | 001 | Örnek-A | ctrl-01 | ctrl-02 | Allele table (a,b,c,d) | Carrier table |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0/1 | 1/1 | 0/0 | 0/1 | 3,1,1,3 | 2,0,1,1 |
| 20 | ./. | 0/. | 0/0 | absent | 0,0,0,2 | 0,0,0,1 |
| 30 | absent | absent | 0/1 | absent | 0,0,1,1 | 0,0,1,0 |
| 40 | 0/0 | 0/0 | 1/1 | 1/1 | 0,4,4,0 | 0,2,2,0 |

POS10 allele Fisher: fixed margins (4,4)/(4,4), denominator C(8,4)=70.
Tables a=0,1,3,4 have probabilities 1,16,16,1 over 70: p=17/35.
OR=9, Woolf CI = exp(log(9) ± 1.959963984540054 * sqrt(8/3)).
Carrier table has only two possible states, equal probability: p=1, OR=+infinity,
CI unavailable. POS40 allele p=2/70=1/35, carrier p=2/6=1/3; both OR=0,
CI unavailable. POS20/30 have no complete cases, so their p and q are null.
BH allele family has two tests: q10=17/35, q40=2/35. Carrier family also has
two tests: q10=1, q40=2/3. Neither null row contributes to the family size.

Four sample columns, four allele rows, twelve observed cells (75% occupancy).
At POS20: cases one no-call + one partial; controls one complete + one absent.
At POS30: cases two absent; controls one complete + one absent. These hand-counted
values are not generated by the production association implementation.

Used by `cohort_contract_tests.cpp`. Full cohort admission/mapping/persistence,
UI and recovery are future integration tests, not implemented fixture behavior.
